sire-roland.description: a broad-shouldered knight with long auburn hair and a full auburn beard, bare-headed, in polished steel plate armour and a royal blue surcoat, riding a white horse covered by a long blue caparison

mortimer.description: a skeletal necromancer with a grinning skull face and a long ragged grey beard, in a tattered black hooded robe, riding a gaunt black horse with a pale bony face and a dark purple saddle cloth

tarka-la-balafree.description: a fierce green-skinned orc warrior woman with a scarred face and a tall black topknot, in fur and leather armour with a purple sash, riding a sturdy brown horse with a shaggy fur saddle

sylvain-le-druide.description: an old druid with a long grey-green beard and a crown of twigs, in a brown and moss-green hooded robe, riding a brown horse with a green saddle cloth

maitre-aldric.description: an old wizard with a long white beard and a tall pointed blue hat with small stars, in a blue robe, riding a white horse with a blue and silver caparison

zarkhan.description: a demonic warlock in black spiked armour with a horned black helmet and glowing orange eyes, riding a black horse whose mane and tail are orange flames

malachar.description: a massive bald purple-skinned warlord with a heavy brow, in a black fur-trimmed cloak over dark purple armour, riding a black horse with a purple saddle cloth

brokk-marteau-noir.description: a stout bald dwarf with a huge braided black beard, in brown leather and steel armour, a black war hammer on his back, riding a big grey ram with large curled horns
